name: Hydroid Krasis
oracle_text:
When you cast this spell, you gain half X life and draw half X cards. Round down each time.
Flying, trample
This creature enters with X +1/+1 counters on it.
blocked_sentences: When you cast this spell, you gain half X life and draw half X cards. Round down each time.

needs.what: a cast trigger (`spell_cast`, `source: self`, `active_zones: ["stack"]`) whose effects read the X the spell was cast with through `{"x": true}` -- i.e. the SPELL_CAST event fired by `Game._cast` must carry `x=item.x` so `triggers.event_bindings` (which lists `x` in EVENT_BINDING_KEYS) overrides the permanent's `cast_x` the way the CYCLED event does for Shark Typhoon
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `{"x": true}` in a triggered ability reads the trigger's `x` binding, which `event_bindings` takes from `obj.cast_x`; `cast_x` is written only in `stack.resolve` when the spell resolves, and the SPELL_CAST payload has no `x`, so the cast trigger would read 0 and gain/draw nothing. The only other route, `half` of (`mana_value_of` self minus 2), reads the mana value rather than X and would be a stand-in, not the printed referent
